reason: The tool call modify_pending_order_items passes item_ids of the three items to remove but new_item_ids as an empty list. Per policy, modifying items in a pending order requires replacing each item with an available new item of the same product but different option ('modify to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'); there is no removal-only mechanism, and the tool schema requires new_item_ids to match item_ids in the same position. An empty new_item_ids array for three item_ids is malformed relative to both the tool contract and policy semantics (also previously rejected by the tool with 'number of items to be exchanged should match'). Additionally, the customer's actual intent is to remove items entirely (keep only helmet and boots), not to swap the three items for three new same-product variants — this is not something the modify-items action supports, since it cannot delete items, only exchange options within the same product type. Proceeding would either error again or, if some default behavior interprets empty new_item_ids as deletion, would go beyond the documented policy procedure, which never authorizes removing items without replacement.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
